source_caption_text:
There’s something about “Droppin Jewels” that still hits every time 🤒🔥

Young Thug’s performance of “Droppin Jewels” during his 2021 Tiny Desk (Home) Concert showed a completely different side of the song. Instead of the usual trap production, Thug performed with a live band in the gardens of the Houdini Estate, giving the track a much more open and soulful feel.

His voice is really what stands out. Thug switches between his normal delivery and those high-pitched vocals throughout the performance, changing his flow without making it feel forced. Even with a live band behind him, he sounds completely comfortable moving between different pockets.

The whole performance is a good reminder of how much Thug can do with his voice. “Droppin Jewels” already stood out on Punk, but hearing it performed live with guitars, keys and drums made the song feel like something completely different.

Via @nprmusic
